answer: Metered attestation fees: a new wallet needs two attestations from wallets older than 90 epochs, and each attester charges a 4 POA fee that is burned. Honest Nectar pays 8 POA once, while 1,000 fakes cost 8,000 POA. Each old wallet, such as Sable, may attest only 3 newcomers per 30 epochs, so an attacker needs 334 aged wallets and cannot reuse one. Auditors mirror the funding graph of 5% of attestations, and a shared source slashes the attester's 10 POA bond by 50%. Limitation: patient attackers can still age wallets.
